about_the_game:
Plot

You play the role of a young cooker in a French restaurant run by a brilliant but domineering Chef. Because of your novice status, you become the main object of his discontent and ridicule. Instead of entrusting you with cooking, the Chef instructs you to peel off the labels from the bananas. However, the situation is complicated: bananas are hidden throughout the restaurant, and access to them is often limited by locked doors, safes, and puzzles. In parallel with the search for bananas, you must serve the late guests of the restaurant, preparing dishes according to strict recipes, and also avoid meetings with the Chef, who constantly pursues you.

The main aspects of gameplay

Search and Explore: Explore the restaurant, search for keys, solve passwords and solve puzzles to find bananas.

Survival: Avoid collisions with the Boss by using shelters, as well as the ability to stun him with various objects.

Object physics: Almost all objects in the game are amenable to interaction — they can be moved, thrown or destroyed.

Cooking: Prepare orders for the guests, strictly following the recipe.

Key Features

Bright antagonist: Chef is a charismatic character with a unique sense of humor that adds dynamism and atmosphere to the game.

Replayability: Random game elements provide a variety of playthroughs.

Interactive environment: The ability to interact with physical objects makes the gameplay more realistic and exciting.

A variety of tasks: From solving puzzles to completing mini-games, the game offers a wide range of activities.

content_descriptors.notes: The voice acting of the characters contains abusive language and insults, as well as jokes on sexual topics

short_description: A first-person horror game with elements of humor in which you play as Oguzok, a young coocker at a famous restaurant. Your goal is to peel off the stickers from the bananas and serve the guests, but the evil Chef chasing you through the restaurant makes completing these tasks a real challenge.

Russian*, English
